item.title: ALBUM REVIEW: Tim Easton Prioritizes Art, Songcraft on Sturdy Indie Release fIREHORSE
item.description: Prolific singer-songwriter Tim Easton is back at it with his 14th LP, fIREHORSE. Consisting of 10 tracks and featuring accompaniment from country star Lainey Wilson’s rhythm section, the album is a paean to songcraft and a testament to Easton’s prodigious gifts as a composer and performer.
